 2 passengers taken into custody after fight on Qatar Airways flight to Chicago
 By
 Elyssa Kaufman 
 Elyssa Kaufman 
 Digital Producer, CBS Chicago 
 Elyssa Kaufman is an Emmy-winning digital news producer at CBS News Chicago. She covers breaking news CBSChicago.com.
 Read Full Bio 
 Elyssa Kaufman 
 Updated on: November 17, 2026 / 6:23 AM CST 
 / CBS Chicago
 Add CBS News on Google 
 Two passengers were taken into custody after a fight on a Qatar Airways flight from Doha to Chicago's O'Hare Airport on Monday. 
 A Qatar Airways spokesperson confirmed there was an "altercation on board flight QR725" and that two passengers were "handed over to local authorities."
 In a statement, the airline said the flight landed safely in Chicago as scheduled despite the incident. 
 The circumstances surrounding the incident were not released. 
 CBS News Chicago has reached out to the FBI for more information.
